title: John the Baptist and the Genealogy of Jesus

questions.question: During whose reign in the fifteenth year did the word of God come to John the son of Zechariah in the wilderness?
options: Tiberius Caesar
Augustus Caesar
Julius Caesar
Claudius
questions.explanation: Luke 3:1-2 (ESV): "In the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar... the word of God came to John the son of Zechariah in the wilderness."

questions.question: John went into all the region around the Jordan, proclaiming what kind of baptism?
options: A baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins
A baptism of fire for the coming judgment
A baptism of the Holy Spirit
A baptism of dedication to the temple
questions.correctAnswer: A baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins
questions.explanation: Luke 3:3 (ESV): "And he went into all the region around the Jordan, proclaiming a baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins."

questions.question: John quotes the prophet Isaiah: "The voice of one crying in the wilderness: 'Prepare the way of the Lord...'" and every what shall be filled?
options: Every valley shall be filled
Every river shall be filled
Every void shall be filled
Every jar shall be filled
questions.explanation: Luke 3:4-5 (ESV): "As it is written in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet... 'Every valley shall be filled, and every mountain and hill shall be made low,'"

questions.question: What did John call the crowds that came out to be baptized by him?
options: You brood of vipers!
You flock of sheep!
You lost souls of Israel!
You children of Abraham!
questions.explanation: Luke 3:7 (ESV): "He said therefore to the crowds that came out to be baptized by him, 'You brood of vipers! Who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?'"

questions.question: John told the crowds not to begin saying to themselves, "We have Abraham as our father." What did he say God is able to do?
options: God is able from these stones to raise up children for Abraham
God is able to destroy all descendants of Abraham
God is able to raise Abraham from the dead
God is able to turn their hearts of stone to flesh
questions.correctAnswer: God is able from these stones to raise up children for Abraham
questions.explanation: Luke 3:8 (ESV): "And do not begin to say to yourselves, 'We have Abraham as our father.' For I tell you, God is able from these stones to raise up children for Abraham."

questions.question: Where did John say the ax is already laid?
options: To the root of the trees
At the door of the temple
Upon the neck of the wicked
At the gates of Jerusalem
questions.correctAnswer: To the root of the trees
questions.explanation: Luke 3:9 (ESV): "Even now the axe is laid to the root of the trees. Every tree therefore that does not bear good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire."

questions.question: When the crowds asked, "What then shall we do?", what was John's response regarding tunics and food?
options: "Whoever has two tunics is to share with him who has none, and whoever has food is to do likewise."
"Sell all your tunics and buy swords."
"Give all your food to the priests in the temple."
"Keep what you have, for a famine is coming."
questions.correctAnswer: "Whoever has two tunics is to share with him who has none, and whoever has food is to do likewise."
questions.explanation: Luke 3:11 (ESV): "And he answered them, 'Whoever has two tunics is to share with him who has none, and whoever has food is to do likewise.'"

questions.question: What did John instruct the tax collectors who came to be baptized?
options: "Collect no more than you are authorized to do."
"Give back fourfold all that you have stolen."
"Abandon your posts and follow me."
"Refuse to work for the Romans."
questions.correctAnswer: "Collect no more than you are authorized to do."
questions.explanation: Luke 3:13 (ESV): "And he said to them, 'Collect no more than you are authorized to do.'"

questions.question: What did John instruct the soldiers who asked him what they should do?
options: "Do not extort money from anyone by threats or by false accusation, and be content with your wages."
"Lay down your weapons and refuse to fight."
"Defend the poor and attack the rich."
"Pray three times a day for forgiveness of blood."
questions.correctAnswer: "Do not extort money from anyone by threats or by false accusation, and be content with your wages."
questions.explanation: Luke 3:14 (ESV): "And he said to them, 'Do not extort money from anyone by threats or by false accusation, and be content with your wages.'"

questions.question: John stated that one who is mightier than he is coming, the strap of whose sandals he is not worthy to untie. With what did John say He will baptize?
options: With the Holy Spirit and fire
With living water
With the power from on high
With blood and truth
questions.correctAnswer: With the Holy Spirit and fire
questions.explanation: Luke 3:16 (ESV): "I baptize you with water, but he who is mightier than I is coming... He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and fire."

questions.question: What is in His hand to clear His threshing floor and gather the wheat into His barn?
options: His winnowing fork
A burning torch
A golden sickle
A great sieve
questions.explanation: Luke 3:17 (ESV): "His winnowing fork is in his hand, to clear his threshing floor and to gather the wheat into his barn..."

questions.question: Why did Herod the tetrarch lock John up in prison?
options: Because John reproved him for Herodias, his brother's wife, and for all the evil things that Herod had done
Because John started a rebellion in the wilderness
Because John refused to pay the temple tax
Because John claimed to be the King of the Jews
questions.correctAnswer: Because John reproved him for Herodias, his brother's wife, and for all the evil things that Herod had done
questions.explanation: Luke 3:19-20 (ESV): "But Herod the tetrarch, who had been reproved by him for Herodias, his brother's wife... added this to them all, that he locked up John in prison."

questions.question: When Jesus was baptized and was praying, the heavens were opened and the Holy Spirit descended on Him in bodily form, like a dove. What did the voice from heaven say?
options: "You are my beloved Son; with you I am well pleased."
"This is the King of Israel, listen to him."
"My favor rests upon you, go and save my people."
"Behold the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world."
questions.correctAnswer: "You are my beloved Son; with you I am well pleased."
questions.explanation: Luke 3:22 (ESV): "...and a voice came from heaven, 'You are my beloved Son; with you I am well pleased.'"

questions.question: About how old was Jesus when He began His ministry?
options: About thirty years of age
About thirty-three years of age
About twenty-five years of age
About forty years of age
questions.explanation: Luke 3:23 (ESV): "Jesus, when he began his ministry, was about thirty years of age, being the son (as was supposed) of Joseph..."

questions.question: According to Luke's genealogy, who was the very first earthly father traced all the way back from Jesus?
options: Adam, the son of God
Abraham, the father of faith
David, the king
Noah, the righteous
questions.explanation: Luke 3:38 (ESV): "the son of Enos, the son of Seth, the son of Adam, the son of God."

key_verse_text: John answered them all, saying, "I baptize you with water, but he who is mightier than I is coming, the strap of whose sandals I am not worthy to untie. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and fire."
